suite.parameters: Existing nominal native profiles unchanged. Engineering fixture, no hardware material fit. Initial velocity assigned once after native settling; compare observed initial states, not seed equality.

suite.excluded: PhysX historical runtime is not admitted to this latest-stable development batch; this does not establish cross-engine material equivalence.
